narrator.label: Narrator
narrator.description: An articulate adult English narrator with warm authority and a thoughtful, varied cadence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Your AI finished the chat, but did it finish the work?

direction.delivery: Conversational and immediately clear; give light emphasis to “finish the work”. Sound interested in the question, not as if revealing a secret.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: AssistOS explores a proposed workplace where people and AI workers can keep a project moving together.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “proposed workplace”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A document needs revising, a piece of research needs checking, or a code change needs review.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “document / research / code change”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The files and earlier decisions should still be there when the next task begins.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “still be there”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book asks how conversation, useful tools, and shared projects could fit together.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “fit together”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You would be able to follow the work, interrupt it, and check what actually changed.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “interrupt it / check”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also examines what must survive when a model or service is replaced.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “must survive”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: For anyone tired of restarting the same conversation, the next question is how to make the work last.

direction.delivery: Warm, unhurried closing; give light emphasis to “make the work last”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.
